name: generate_image
description: Generate an image via Gemini, OpenAI or Kinovi. Text-to-image or reference-conditioned.

output.description: Path to the generated image file

params.name: out
params.description: Output image path (.png). Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: aspect-ratio
params.description: Gemini and Kinovi. E.g. '9:16', '1:1' (Kinovi: per model, e.g. gpt-image-2 and seedream-5.0-pro also auto). Ignored by OpenAI.

params.name: model
params.description: Override the connector's default model for the chosen provider. Kinovi: nanobanana-pro (default), nanobanana2, gpt-image-2, seedream-5.0-pro.

params.name: quality
params.description: Kinovi gpt-image-2 only: low, medium or high (price rises with it).
